Package index

Migration from MiscMetabar

Functions migrated from MiscMetabar that operate on a single phyloseq object.

wheat_plot()
Wheat plot of a numeric distribution
reorder_distinct_colors()
Reorder fill and color scales to maximize perceptual contrast between adjacent segments
plot_tax_count_pq()
Plot taxonomic counts (non-proportion) in function of a factor with stacked bars

Migration from comparpq

Functions migrated from comparpq (single-phyloseq variant).

gg_bubbles_pq()
Circle-packed bubble plot of a phyloseq object using ggplot2

Migration from taxinfo

Theme and palette helpers migrated from taxinfo.

theme_idest()
ggplot theme for IdEst
idest_pal
IdEst color palettes
idest_colors()
IdEst colors for ggplot theme_idest
scale_color_idest_c()
IdEst continuous color scales for ggplot2
scale_fill_idest_c()
IdEst continuous fill scales for ggplot2
scale_color_idest_d()
IdEst discrete color scales for ggplot2
scale_fill_idest_d()
IdEst discrete fill scales for ggplot2

New visualisation functions

Pure-ggplot2 helpers for phyloseq objects (geoms, themes, scales, palettes).

break_outlier_axis()
Add axis breaks to show outlier values
zoom_outlier_axis()
Zoom into the non-outlier region and annotate outliers with arrows
comet_pq()
Comet plot for paired or multi-step measurements from a phyloseq object
community_sharing_plot()
Community sharing plot: modalities as pie nodes with multi-metric links
community_sharing_barplot()
Companion bar chart for community_sharing_plot()
make_sharing_metric()
Build a single metric definition for community_sharing_plot()
default_sharing_metrics()
Default metrics for community_sharing_plot()
krona_like_pq()
Krona-like interactive taxonomy plot from a phyloseq object
palette_earthtones()
Derive a colour palette from a geographic location
plot_sample_depth_pq()
Plot per-sample read depth (number of sequences)
plot_tax_table_pq()
Plot a compact distribution overview of tax_table columns
plot_taxa_heatmap_pq()
Heatmap of the top-N most abundant taxa across samples
scale_color_pq_discrete()
ggplot2 discrete colour scale using the IdEst palette family
scale_fill_pq_discrete()
ggplot2 discrete fill scale using the IdEst palette family
ternary_biomarker_pq()
Ternary plot of biomarker taxa across three sample groups
ternary_pq()
Ternary and diamond plots for 3-or-4-group taxon compositions
theme_pq_minimal()
A pared-down minimalist ggplot2 theme for ggplotpq

New single-phyloseq analysis wrappers

Analysis wrappers that ship a ggplot (the analysis lives here, the plot is the deliverable).

plot_samples_dist2ref_pq()
Distance of every sample to a reference (control) sample set
neg_control_diag_pq()
Diagnose contamination from negative controls

Workflow tracking

Helpers to visualise workflow tracking output from MiscMetabar.

track_wkflow_formattable()
Formattable view of track_wkflow output with nesting tree
